lines.t: from dust a promise breathed in the garden seed of abraham's sons counted like stars
Out of nations, a people set apart
Chosen for covenant, blessed by vows of old
Yet not all who wear the name walk in the steps
And the land called holy holds both the wheat and chaff
Olive tree planted in ancient soil
Roots swooned deep in prophet's word
Some branches broken, cast away
Others grafted in
Gentile wild to native true
One tree, many fruits, some born of faith
All upheld by the faithfulness of God
Not all are Israel who claim the name
Nor do all inherit ancestral claim
Some say they are Jews but walk not in truth
For only those who keep covenant shine
The commonwealth gathered, one body, one mind
The promises living in hearts made new
Ooh, physical sun, stone hearts turned away, tied to the gift the Messiah scorned.
Yet God's mercy awaits, always calls, remnant, preserve the testimony, endures.
A bride made ready, adorned in grace
Church in Israel, one voice in praise
From two he makes one, the wall torn down
No longer divided, but one through the Lamb
The church not made with hands, living stones
Bride betrothed to the king, waiting for dawn
All nations gather, call to the feast
Sons and daughters redeemed and released
Olive tree awakened, old wound healed
Broken returned, wild sons revealed
Inheritance sure for all who believe
The Israel of God by faith receive
The promise remains, the root stands strong
In Mashiach alone do we belong
God cannot forsake what His Word has begun
Every covenant stands in the sun
Mercy extends to every repentant heart
All are called but few set apart
Inheritance not by flesh but spirit birth
Come in wealth
Rebuilt on the cornerstone's word
Hold not to pride
Nor boast in blood
The true Jew in word
Humble in love
Branches restored
A mystery revealed
The fullness of Gentiles
A veil repealed
Promises not broken
But waiting to bloom
Bride and Israel made one
Forever immune
The remnant returns, the people we bore
From every nation, a whirlwind drawn
In Zion the feast, inheritance bright
Pride adorned for the coming night
Stand in the promise, sing to the King Israel restored, all creation will sing
Israel, root and branch and stalk Crafted for glory, no longer alone
All covenants fulfilled, all promises stand The Israel of God
God held in his hand
